items.title: HIG Q3 deep dive: margin discipline offsets competitive growth headwinds
items.summary: Insurance and financial services company The Hartford (NYSE:HIG) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as sales rose 3.9% year on year to $7.22 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.50 per share was 10.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
